tooltip.skycraft.guide.handbook: Everything a newcomer to Skyrim should know. Use it to read.
guide.skycraft.title: The Traveler's Handbook
guide.skycraft.subtitle: Being a plain guide to Skyrim and the lands of Nirn, for those newly arrived
guide.skycraft.how_to_read: Turn pages with the arrows, A and D, or the mouse wheel. Click a chapter to open it.
guide.skycraft.hints.off: Tutorial hints are off. Type /handbook hints on to bring them back.
guide.skycraft.chapter.getting_started.t:
You begin as a nobody: someone who wakes in a cottage above Helgen to the sound of a dragon burning the town. What you become is up to you.

# Your first hour
* Choose your race in the character creator. It sets your starting skills, a few lifelong gifts and one greater power.
* Walk down the road to ruined Helgen, find a survivor, and carry the warning to Riverwood.
* Carry word of the dragon to the Jarl of Whiterun. The main quest, The Dragonborn, starts here.
---
# How Skycraft differs from Minecraft
* You get better at what you do. Swing a sword and One-Handed rises; mine ore and Mining rises.
* You can't dig the land at first. Ore veins and trees are fair game, but soil needs the Mining perk Excavator (Mining 10), stone needs Stonebreaker (30) and the deepest rock Deep Delver (75). Blocks you placed yourself always come back.
* Health regenerates slowly and almost stops in a fight. Eat, drink potions or cast healing spells.
---
# Where to look next
* {key:key.skycraft.hub} opens the menu hub: Skills, Items, Magic and Map.
* {key:key.skycraft.journal} opens your journal: quests, factions, party and stats.
* {key:key.skycraft.map} opens the map of Tamriel.
* Small hints appear in the top-left corner the first time you try something new.

Lost this book? Type /handbook to read it anyway.
guide.skycraft.chapter.controls.text:
These are your current keys. Change them in Options, Controls, Key Binds, under Skycraft.

# Menus
* {key:key.inventory}: inventory
* {key:key.skycraft.hub}: menu hub
* {key:key.skycraft.skills}: skills and perks
* {key:key.skycraft.journal}: journal and party
* {key:key.skycraft.magic_menu}: magic and shouts
* {key:key.skycraft.map}: map and fast travel
* {key:key.skycraft.reputation}: reputation
* {key:key.skycraft.wait}: wait
---
# In the world
* {key:key.skycraft.interact}: talk, loot, pick up, use
* {key:key.attack}: attack, or cast your right-hand spell. Hold it for a power attack.
* {key:key.use}: hold to block, or cast your left-hand spell
* {key:key.skycraft.shout}: shout or use a power. Hold it longer for more words.
* {key:key.skycraft.favorites}: favorites. Keys 1 to 8 equip favorites 1 to 8.
---
* {key:key.sneak}: sneak
* {key:key.skycraft.dodge}: dodge roll (needs the Dodge Roll perk)
* {key:key.skycraft.call_horse}: call your horse
* {key:key.skycraft.sheathe}: ready or sheathe your weapon
* {key:key.skycraft.stone_power}: Standing Stone power
* {key:key.playerlist}: player list

# Sneaking actions
* Sneak and use a townsperson to pickpocket them.
* Sneak and use a body to drag it.
---
# Controllers and the Steam Deck
Gamepads work out of the box. The pack sets up Steam button icons, a virtual mouse cursor in menus, and button hints.

# Inside the inventory
* W and S choose an item; A and D change the tab.
* E uses or equips, F adds a favorite, R sorts, X inspects, Q drops.
* The Crafting button opens the plain Minecraft inventory.
guide.skycraft.chapter.races.text:
Twenty-three peoples can be played. Each starts every skill at 15, with +10 in one skill and +5 in five others, and has one greater power. You can use the power every few minutes (see the HUD timer) with {key:key.skycraft.shout} once you've equipped it in the magic menu.
---
# The ten of Skyrim
* **Nord**: frost resistance, Battle Cry
* **Imperial**: extra gold, Voice of the Emperor
* **Breton**: magic resistance, Dragonskin
* **Redguard**: poison resistance, Adrenaline Rush
* **High Elf**: extra Magicka, Highborn
* **Wood Elf**: resists poison and disease, Command Animal
* **Dark Elf**: fire resistance, Ancestor's Wrath
* **Orc**: Berserker Rage
* **Khajiit**: claws, soft landings, Night Eye
* **Argonian**: water breathing, resists disease, Histskin
---
# Other peoples of Tamriel
The sea-elf Maormer, the Reachmen, the Ohmes-raht, the Lilmothiit and the Imga.

# From Akavir
The serpent Tsaesci, who climb walls; the tiger-folk Ka Po' Tun; and the monkey-folk Tang Mo.

# The lost races
Atmorans, Falmer, Dwemer, Ayleids and Kothringi.
---
Some races have sub-peoples that change only your looks: Colovian and Nibenese Imperials, Stronghold and Wood Orcs, Suthay-raht and Cathay-raht Khajiit, and Saxhleel, Naga and Agaceph Argonians.

The townsfolk you meet are drawn from the same peoples, in the mix their homeland has.
guide.skycraft.chapter.skills.text:
There are 29 skills. Each one rises as you use it, from 15 up to 100.

# The Warrior
One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery, Block, Heavy Armor, Smithing, Unarmed and Polearms.

# The Mage
Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion, Mysticism and Enchanting.
---
# The Thief
Light Armor, Sneak, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Speech, Alchemy and Acrobatics.

# The life skills
Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Hunting, Athletics, Riding and Cooking.
---
# Leveling up
Every skill increase also counts toward your character level. When you level up, press {key:key.skycraft.skills}: choose Health, Magicka or Stamina (+10), and you also get a perk point.

# Look to the heavens
The skills screen is a night sky with a constellation for each skill: 255 perks in all. Pick a star and spend a point on it if you meet its requirements.
---
# Other ways to improve
* **Trainers** teach for gold, up to five lessons per level.
* **Skill books** raise a skill the first time you read them.
* **Standing Stones** speed up whole groups of skills.
* **Legendary**: a skill at 100 can be reset to 15 to get its perks back and grow it again.
guide.skycraft.chapter.magic.text:
# Spells
There are 115 spells in six schools: Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion and Mysticism. They come in five tiers, from Novice to Master. Learn a spell by reading its tome. You'll find tomes in dungeons, and court wizards sell them.
---
# Casting
Equip spells to either hand in the magic menu ({key:key.skycraft.magic_menu}). {key:key.attack} casts the right hand and {key:key.use} the left. Click to cast a fire-and-forget spell, or hold for a concentration spell. A spell trains its school only when it actually does something.
---
# Making magic
* **Spellmaking Altar**: combine up to four effects you know into a spell of your own.
* **Staff Enchanter**: bind a spell into a staff with a filled soul gem.
* **Arcane Enchanter**: break down an enchanted item to learn its enchantment, then put that enchantment on your own gear.
---
# The Thu'um
There are 26 shouts, each with three Words of Power. Word Walls in old Nordic ruins teach a word. Each dragon soul you absorb unlocks one word you've learned.

Hold {key:key.skycraft.shout} to shout: the longer you hold it, the more words you use. Each shout must recharge before you can use it again.
---
# Dragons
Dragons circle, breathe fire or frost, and land to bite. Everyone close by absorbs a slain dragon's soul. Dragonrend forces a dragon to the ground.

# Standing Stones
There are thirteen guardian stones across Skyrim. Touch one to take its blessing. Only one blessing is active at a time.
guide.skycraft.chapter.combat.text:
# Weapons
Daggers, swords, war axes and maces train One-Handed. Greatswords, battleaxes and warhammers train Two-Handed. Spears, halberds and glaives train Polearms, and bows and crossbows train Archery. Each family has its own perks: axes make enemies bleed, maces break through armor, and swords score critical hits.
---
# Power attacks
Hold {key:key.attack}, or attack while sprinting. A power attack costs Stamina, hits for 1.5 times the damage (1.75 with two hands) and staggers the target.

# Blocking
Hold {key:key.use} to block with your weapon or shield. Blocking costs Stamina. A shield blocks far more than a blade.
---
# Sneak attacks
Strike a target that hasn't noticed you: three times the damage with one-handed weapons, and twice with bows. Perks raise this, up to fifteen times with a dagger.

# Armor
Heavy and Light Armor protect you better as the skill rises. Heavy armor slows you down until you learn Conditioning.
---
# Gear
There are 48 armor sets and nearly two hundred weapons, from Iron to Daedric and Dragonbone, plus the arms of every province. Temper them at a grindstone or workbench, from Fine up to Legendary.

# Enemies grow with you
Creatures and bandits scale to your level and take grander titles as they do.
guide.skycraft.chapter.stealth.text:
# Sneaking
Hold {key:key.sneak} to sneak. The eye above your crosshair opens as people grow aware of you. Darkness, skill and light armor help you stay hidden. Heavy armor makes you easier to spot. Anyone you've hit recently knows where you are.
---
# Lockpicking
Some chests and doors are locked, from Novice to Master. Move the pick with the mouse and turn the lock with A or D. Turn it too hard in the wrong place and the pick breaks.

# Pickpocketing
Sneak up behind someone and use them while you sneak. Each item shows your chance of taking it unseen.
---
# Crime
A crime counts only if someone sees it. Your bounty is kept separately in each hold.
* Trespass 5, pickpocketing 25, assault 40, murder 1000
* Theft: half the stolen goods' value

Stolen goods are marked. Only fences will buy them.
---
# Guards
A guard will stop you. You can pay the bounty, go to jail, talk your way out, or bribe them (this needs a perk). If you resist, you fight. With a bounty of 1000 or more, guards attack on sight.

In jail, sleeping in your cell bed serves your sentence. When you're released, you lose your stolen goods and some skill progress.
guide.skycraft.chapter.economy.text:
# Septims
Coins go straight into your purse and weigh nothing. Type /gold to see your balance, /pay to give coins to another player, and /withdraw to turn coins back into items.

# Trade
Merchants have their own goods and gold, and they restock every two days. Your Speech skill and perks set your prices.
---
# Making money
Quests, bounties and faction contracts; selling loot, ore, pelts, firewood and fish; and the things you smith, brew and enchant.

# Crafting
* **Forge, smelter, tanning rack**: weapons and armor
* **Grindstone, workbench**: tempering
* **Alchemy lab**: potions. Each ingredient has four effects, which you learn by eating it or brewing with it.
* **Cooking pot**: meals
---
# Houses
Five cities have a house for sale: Breezehome in Whiterun (5,000), Honeyside in Riften and Vlindrel Hall in Markarth (8,000 each), Hjerim in Windhelm (12,000) and Proudspire Manor in Solitude (25,000). Ask the Jarl or the steward. Furnishings cost extra.
---
# Homesteads
Buy land at Lakeview, Windstad or Heljarchen (5,000), or stake a claim of your own. Build your home at a drafting table: a small house, then a main hall, wings, a cellar, a garden, an animal pen and a workshop. You can hire a steward to look after it.

# Carry weight
You can carry 300, plus more for each Stamina increase. Carry more than that and you slow down and can't sprint or fast travel.
guide.skycraft.chapter.survival.text:
Survival Mode is on by default. Small meters above your health bar track three needs.

# Hunger
You go from Peckish to Starving, and hunger eats into your Stamina. Eat cooked meals: the cook's skill makes them better.

# Fatigue
You go from Tired to Debilitated, and fatigue drains your Magicka. Sleep in a bed or at an inn to become Well Rested. A bedroll or tent only leaves you Rested.
---
# Cold
You go from Chilly to Numb, and cold lowers your health. Fur, hide and Nordic gear keep you warm, and so do hoods and cloaks. Fires, forges, shelter and hot stew warm you. Cold water can kill. Nords feel the cold less.

Operators can turn Survival Mode off with /gamerule skycraftSurvivalMode false.
---
# Camping
Carry a bedroll (it never sets your respawn point), a hide tent and a campfire kit.

# Fishing
There are 52 kinds of fish. What bites depends on the water, the region, the hour, the weather and the depth. Look for jumping fish. When one bites, reel in while the marker crosses the gold zone.
---
# Death
What you carried stays on your body where you fell. It is marked on the map and compass, and you and your party can loot it.

# Disease
Creatures carry ten diseases. Cure them with a potion, by praying at a shrine, or by paying a priest.
guide.skycraft.chapter.factions.text:
# Joinable factions
The Companions, the College of Winterhold, the Thieves Guild, the Dark Brotherhood, the Imperial Legion, the Stormcloaks and the Bards College. Each has its own ranks, trials and contracts.
---
# Quests
There are 98 story quests: the main quest, The Dragonborn; each faction's storyline; the Civil War; Dawnguard; the Daedric Princes; Solstheim; and the other provinces. On top of these come favors for townsfolk, Jarls' bounties and legendary hunts.

Your journal ({key:key.skycraft.journal}) lists them. Track a quest to see it on your compass.
---
# People
Townsfolk keep daily routines and remember how you treat them. Do them favors and they come to like you. Friends can become followers, and with an Amulet of Mara you can marry.

# Reputation
{key:key.skycraft.reputation} shows where you stand with twelve factions, from Hated to Revered. Factions that hate you send killers after you.
guide.skycraft.chapter.world.text:
The whole continent of Tamriel lies at full scale. One block is about a meter, and Skyrim alone is some six thousand blocks across. Whiterun stands at the center of the map.
---
# The provinces
Skyrim's nine holds and Solstheim; then Cyrodiil, Morrowind, High Rock, Hammerfell, Black Marsh, Elsweyr, Valenwood and the Summerset Isles. Each has its own lands, peoples, towns, ruins and music. Danger grows the farther you go from Whiterun.
---
# Beyond the sea
Atmora lies to the north, Akavir to the east, Yokuda to the west, and Pyandonea and Thras to the south-west. Past them are endless uncharted lands.

# Places
More than six hundred named places: cities, towns, barrows, forts, Dwemer ruins, Standing Stones, Word Walls, dragon mounds and shrines. Each one you find goes on your map.
---
# Travel
* **Fast travel**: open the map ({key:key.skycraft.map}) and pick a place you've discovered. You can't fast travel in combat or while carrying too much.
* **Carriages** wait outside the cities. They go to any city in their province, and to cities you've discovered in other provinces.
* **Horses** are sold at stables, and wild ones can be tamed. Call your horse with {key:key.skycraft.call_horse}.
* **Silt striders** carry you between Vvardenfell's towns.
---
# Roads
Roads link the settlements, with signposts and lanterns. Caravans, travelers and patrols use them, and so do bandits.

# Other realms
The Nether is Oblivion, and the End is Sovngarde.
guide.skycraft.chapter.multiplayer.text:
# Hosting from your own PC
Essential is part of the pack, so nobody has to forward ports.
* Everyone installs the same Skycraft instance and adds each other as friends in the Essential menu.
* The host opens their world and chooses Host World or Invite Friends from the Essential menu.
* Friends accept the invite and join.
---
# Parties
Create a party in your journal ({key:key.skycraft.journal}), or with /party create and /party invite. Party members share quests and rewards, show on the map and compass, and can fast travel to each other. When you join a world, you're offered a trip to your party leader.
---
# Sharing the world
* To wait or sleep, everyone online must agree.
* Each player gets their own loot from every dungeon chest.
* Your party can loot your body if you fall.
* Attacking another player counts as a crime.

A dedicated server works the same way. docs/INSTALL.md in the Skycraft repository explains how to set one up.
guide.skycraft.hint.welcome: Welcome to Skyrim. Your **Traveler's Handbook** is in your pack. Hold it and press {key:key.use} to read it, or type /handbook.
guide.skycraft.hint.menus: Press {key:key.skycraft.hub} for the menu hub: Skills, Items, Magic and Map. {key:key.skycraft.journal} opens your journal.
guide.skycraft.hint.sneak: You are sneaking. The eye above your crosshair shows how aware others are of you. Strike an unaware foe for a sneak attack.
guide.skycraft.hint.combat: Hold {key:key.attack} for a power attack and {key:key.use} to block. Both use Stamina.
guide.skycraft.hint.low_health: Your health is low. Health barely recovers in a fight: eat, drink a potion or cast a healing spell. {key:key.skycraft.favorites} opens your favorites.
guide.skycraft.hint.lockpick: Move the pick with the mouse and turn the lock with A or D. If the lock resists, stop before the pick breaks.
guide.skycraft.hint.pickpocket: Each item shows your chance of taking it unseen. If you're caught, you get a bounty.
guide.skycraft.hint.word_wall: You learned a Word of Power. Unlock it with a dragon soul in the magic menu ({key:key.skycraft.magic_menu}), then hold {key:key.skycraft.shout} to shout.
guide.skycraft.hint.dragon_soul: You absorbed a dragon soul. Spend it in the magic menu ({key:key.skycraft.magic_menu}) to unlock a Word of Power.
guide.skycraft.hint.magic: Equip spells to your hands in the magic menu ({key:key.skycraft.magic_menu}). {key:key.attack} casts the right hand and {key:key.use} the left.
guide.skycraft.hint.level_up: You can level up. Press {key:key.skycraft.skills} to raise Health, Magicka or Stamina and spend your perk points.
guide.skycraft.hint.cold: You're getting cold. Wear warm clothing, find shelter, or stand by a fire. Cold water is deadly.
guide.skycraft.hint.hunger: You're getting hungry, and it's sapping your Stamina. Eat a meal. Cooked food does the most good.
guide.skycraft.hint.fatigue: You're tired, and it's draining your Magicka. Sleep in a bed or at an inn to become Well Rested.
guide.skycraft.hint.fishing: When a fish bites, press {key:key.use} to reel in while the marker is inside the gold zone. Different waters, hours and weather bring different fish.
guide.skycraft.hint.discovery: You discovered a location. Open the map ({key:key.skycraft.map}) to fast travel back to it later.
guide.skycraft.hint.bounty: You have a bounty in this hold. Guards will confront you: pay, go to jail, or talk your way out.
guide.skycraft.hint.overencumbered: You're carrying too much. You can't sprint or fast travel until you drop or sell something.
guide.skycraft.hint.horse: Horses are fast but can't fight for you. Call yours with {key:key.skycraft.call_horse}. Riding trains the Riding skill.
guide.skycraft.hint.oblivion: This is Oblivion, the realm of the Daedra. Tread carefully.
guide.skycraft.hint.dragon: A dragon! Hit it with arrows and spells while it flies. Strike hard when it lands. Its soul is yours if it dies near you.
skycraft.guide.arrive.whiterun: Golden tundra grass bends before the wind where Dragonsreach crowns the plains of Whiterun Hold.
skycraft.guide.rumour.whiterun: Jarl Balgruuf seeks word of the dragon attack at Helgen, and the Companions of Jorrvaskr are testing new blood.
skycraft.guide.arrive.falkreath: Mist clings to the dark pines and mossy headstones of Falkreath Hold, where every barrow keeps a restless memory.
skycraft.guide.rumour.falkreath: Travellers whisper of a talking dog on the road outside Falkreath and bandits fortifying the pine-shadowed passes.
skycraft.guide.arrive.the_rift: Amber birch leaves drift across the lakes and high ridges of the Rift under an eternal autumn sky.
skycraft.guide.rumour.the_rift: Brynjolf in Riften's marketplace is looking for nimble hands, while the Dawnguard muster at Fort Dawnguard to the east.
skycraft.guide.arrive.eastmarch: Steam rises from sulfur pools where ancient Nordic stones meet the snow-swept marches of Windhelm.
skycraft.guide.rumour.eastmarch: Ulfric Stormcloak gathers his banners in the Palace of the Kings, and townsfolk speak of a boy performing the Black Sacrament.
skycraft.guide.arrive.the_pale: Bitter gales off the Sea of Ghosts scour the white plains and lonely watchtowers of the Pale.
skycraft.guide.rumour.the_pale: The people of Dawnstar cannot sleep for waking nightmares, and a priest of Mara at Nightcaller Temple seeks aid.
skycraft.guide.arrive.winterhold: Broken cliffs of ice and stone stand defiant above the freezing surf where the Great Collapse claimed old Winterhold.
skycraft.guide.rumour.winterhold: The College of Winterhold still welcomes mages across its perilous bridge, investigating an ancient orb buried in Saarthal.
skycraft.guide.arrive.hjaalmarch: Cold fog coils over the black reed-beds and sunken barrows of Hjaalmarch's haunted salt marshes.
skycraft.guide.rumour.hjaalmarch: A burned house in Morthal has the Jarl on edge, and dark shapes move among the marsh-lights after sundown.
skycraft.guide.arrive.haafingar: High upon its great stone arch above the Karth estuary, Solitude watches the ships of the Empire come and go.
skycraft.guide.rumour.haafingar: General Tullius commands the Legion from Castle Dour, while the Bards College prepares for the burning of King Olaf's effigy.
skycraft.guide.arrive.the_reach: Sheer crags of silver-veined stone plunge into roaring cataracts where Dwemer brass gleams in the Reach.
skycraft.guide.rumour.the_reach: Forsworn rebels strike the silver caravans outside Markarth, and vigilant eyes watch an abandoned house in the lower keep.
skycraft.guide.arrive.alikr_desert: Endless red dunes shimmer beneath a relentless sun from Sentinel's domes to the buried halls of the Alik'r.
skycraft.guide.rumour.alikr_desert: Ash'abah nomads warn that risen Ra Gada dead stir in the desert tombs outside Sentinel.
skycraft.guide.arrive.bangkorai: Craggy passes guard the borderlands of Bangkorai where northern pines give way to sun-baked canyon stone.
skycraft.guide.rumour.bangkorai: Mercenary companies along the Bangkorai Garrison road are hiring blades to hold the canyon gates.
skycraft.guide.arrive.craglorn: Red mesas and fallen star-stones scar the high badlands of Craglorn beneath troubled constellations.
skycraft.guide.rumour.craglorn: Scholars in Elinhir offer heavy coin to anyone brave enough to enter the Star-Gazer citadels.
skycraft.guide.arrive.dragontail: Wind-carved peaks and dry gullies rise along the Dragontail range between Hammerfell and the northern holds.
skycraft.guide.rumour.dragontail: Caravan masters in Rihad post bounties on mountain raiders blocking the Dragontail passes.
skycraft.guide.arrive.hews_bane: Lantern-lit coves and limestone arches shelter the corsair harbors of Hew's Bane.
skycraft.guide.rumour.hews_bane: Merchant princes in Taneth whisper of sunken treasure and rival syndicates along Abah's Landing.
skycraft.guide.arrive.stros_mkai: Warm trade winds carry the scent of salt and brassworks across the island port of Stros M'Kai.
skycraft.guide.rumour.stros_mkai: Dockmasters on Stros M'Kai seek crews to clear Dwemer automatons from the headland ruins.
skycraft.guide.arrive.glenumbra: Ancientstanding stones and rain-washed moors roll westward toward the proud spires of Daggerfall.
skycraft.guide.rumour.glenumbra: Wyrd sisters on the Glenumbra moors warn of Bloodthorn cultists defiling the ancient barrows.
skycraft.guide.arrive.rivenspire: Jagged slate ridges and brooding keeps cast long shadows across the windswept valleys of Rivenspire.
skycraft.guide.rumour.rivenspire: Noble houses in Shornhelm seek sellswords to lift the crimson curse gripping the northern crags.
skycraft.guide.arrive.stormhaven: Salt spray from the Iliac Bay mists the Pennant-hung watchtowers and green hills of Stormhaven.
skycraft.guide.rumour.stormhaven: Knights of the Flame are recruiting travellers to put an end to nightmares haunting the abbey roads.
skycraft.guide.arrive.bjoulsae: Horsemen and river-barges follow the winding Bjoulsae from grassy downs to busy market fords.
skycraft.guide.rumour.bjoulsae: River wardens in Evermor offer bounties on Reach raiders crossing the Bjoulsae fords.
skycraft.guide.arrive.wayrest: Merchant galleons crowd the estuary beneath the grand counting-houses and gardens of Wayrest.
skycraft.guide.rumour.wayrest: Court intrigues and corsair blockades have Wayrest's guildhalls posting urgent contracts.
skycraft.guide.arrive.wrothgar: Iron-gray peaks and smoking clan-forges rise over the snowbound strongholds of Wrothgar.
skycraft.guide.rumour.wrothgar: Forge-mothers in Orsinium call for warriors to reclaim ancient clan relics from the Winterborn.
skycraft.guide.arrive.jerall_mountains: Snow-laden passes along the Jerall crest look down upon the northern marches of Cyrodiil.
skycraft.guide.rumour.jerall_mountains: Scouts in Bruma report Pale Pass relics surfacing as the mountain snows thaw.
skycraft.guide.arrive.colovian_highlands: Oak-crowned hills and stone estates stand watch over the proud Colovian West.
skycraft.guide.rumour.colovian_highlands: Countess Valga's stewards in Chorrol post rewards for clearing goblins from the highland mines.
skycraft.guide.arrive.heartlands: Across the sparkling waters of Lake Rumare, White-Gold Tower gleams at the heart of the Empire.
skycraft.guide.rumour.heartlands: The Elder Council and Arenamasters of the Imperial City have work for every blade and scholar.
skycraft.guide.arrive.great_forest: Sunlight filters through ancient oaks and white Ayleid arches deep within the Great Forest.
skycraft.guide.rumour.great_forest: Priests at Weynon Priory speak of Ayleid welkynd stones awakening in the forest ruins.
skycraft.guide.arrive.nibenay_basin: Willow-lined streams and painted bridges wind beneath the eastern foothills of the Nibenay Basin.
skycraft.guide.rumour.nibenay_basin: Painters and knights in Cheydinhal seek adventurers to investigate disappearances in the eastern hills.
skycraft.guide.arrive.west_weald: Rolling vineyards and golden pastures stretch between the stone walls of Skingrad and the Valenwood border.
skycraft.guide.rumour.west_weald: Vintners in Skingrad offer generous coin to guard their cellars and hunt beasts in the Weald.
skycraft.guide.arrive.gold_coast: Warm sea breezes stir the olive groves and whitewashed port of Anvil along the Abecean shore.
skycraft.guide.rumour.gold_coast: Anvil's lighthouse keeper and harbor guild post bounties on smugglers working the coastal caves.
skycraft.guide.arrive.nibenay_valley: River mists drift past sunken shrines and bustling timber docks along the lower Niben.
skycraft.guide.rumour.nibenay_valley: Watchmen in Bravil warn of Dreamworld apparitions and skooma dens along the bay.
skycraft.guide.arrive.blackwood: Cypress roots and lantern-lit causeways wind through the dark border-marshes of Blackwood.
skycraft.guide.rumour.blackwood: The Fighters Guild in Leyawiin is hiring hunters to drive Blackwood Company raiders from the bogs.
skycraft.guide.arrive.stonefalls: Rivers of glowing magma and ash-plumes shadow the fungal groves and Dunmer keeps of Stonefalls.
skycraft.guide.rumour.stonefalls: Grandmasters in Ebonheart call for heroes to seal the Daedric fissures opening below Ash Mountain.
skycraft.guide.arrive.deshaan: Silt-striders stride across fertile valleys toward the temple-domes of Mournhold.
skycraft.guide.rumour.deshaan: Ordinators in Mournhold seek aid stamping out the Llodos plague in the western quarantines.
skycraft.guide.arrive.molag_amur: Scorched ash-wastes and jagged lava fields stretch toward the white walls of Necrom.
skycraft.guide.rumour.molag_amur: Keepers of the dead in Necrom ask travellers to quiet ancestral spirits disturbed in the ash-tombs.
skycraft.guide.arrive.telvannis: Giant mushroom towers twist skyward over the island archipelagos of House Telvanni.
skycraft.guide.rumour.telvannis: Wizard-lords in Sadrith Mora pay well for rare alchemical salts and Dwemerton schematics.
skycraft.guide.arrive.sheogorad: Lonely stone spires and wave-battered islets mark the northern reach of Sheogorad.
skycraft.guide.rumour.sheogorad: Pilgrims on Dagon Fel speak of eccentric shrines and daedric riddles hidden among the islands.
skycraft.guide.arrive.vvardenfell_ashlan: Choking ash-winds sweep across giant chitin shells and cairns in the shadow of Red Mountain.
skycraft.guide.rumour.vvardenfell_ashlan: Redoran councillors in Ald'ruhn seek champions to brave the ashstorms and Sixth House caverns.
skycraft.guide.arrive.grazelands: Open emerald plains and goldenwick pastures sustain the Ashlander camps of the Grazelands.
skycraft.guide.rumour.grazelands: Wise women of the Zainab camp trade prophecies and bounties for daedric hearts.
skycraft.guide.arrive.azuras_coast: Basalt columns and towering fungal caps overlook the eastern bays of Azura's Coast.
skycraft.guide.rumour.azuras_coast: Priests at the Shrine of Azura foretell a star-marked traveller walking the eastern shore.
skycraft.guide.arrive.west_gash: Stepped river valleys and scrub-covered hills link the Hlaalu trade towns of the West Gash.
skycraft.guide.rumour.west_gash: Caius Cosades and the guild halls of Balmora have orders waiting for resourceful blades.
skycraft.guide.arrive.bitter_coast: Bioluminescent spores and mangrove roots glow through the warm fog of the Bitter Coast.
skycraft.guide.rumour.bitter_coast: Harbor clerks in Seyda Neen offer coin to clear smuggler caves along the swamp channels.
skycraft.guide.arrive.ascadian_isles: Calm canals and mushroom-shaded plantations surround the cantons of Vivec City.
skycraft.guide.rumour.ascadian_isles: Temple buoyancy armigers in Vivec seek investigators for cult activity in the underworks.
skycraft.guide.arrive.red_mountain: Smoke and red lightning crown the caldera of Dagoth Ur at the burning heart of Vvardenfell.
skycraft.guide.rumour.red_mountain: Ghostgate sentinels warn that only those bearing ancient wards should cross into the blight.
skycraft.guide.arrive.solstheim: Ash from the south meets northern rime across the pine forests and Raven Rock mines of Solstheim.
skycraft.guide.rumour.solstheim: Townsfolk at the Wind Stone walk in a trance at night, speaking the name of Miraak.
skycraft.guide.arrive.shadowfen: Hanging moss and sunken Xanmeer steps rise from the mist-shrouded waters of Shadowfen.
skycraft.guide.rumour.shadowfen: Tree-Minders ask travellers to protect the Hist sap-vats from relic hunters.
skycraft.guide.arrive.stormhold: Ancient Imperial stonework and Argonian mud-domes mingle in the border city of Stormhold.
skycraft.guide.rumour.stormhold: Vicecanon Heita-Meen seeks investigators to uncover plots threatening Stormhold's peace.
skycraft.guide.arrive.helstrom: Dense root-tangles and spore-thick channels guard the impenetrably deep interior of Helstrom.
skycraft.guide.rumour.helstrom: Hist-speakers in Helstrom offer rare blessings to outsiders who prove their respect for the marsh.
skycraft.guide.arrive.gideon: Weathered Kothringi pillars and flooded plazas mark the western marshlands of Gideon.
skycraft.guide.rumour.gideon: Scouts in Gideon post bounties on rogue marsh-predators stalking the western causeways.
skycraft.guide.arrive.lilmoth: Salt-tides and river silt meet among the trading wharves and sunken temples of Lilmoth.
skycraft.guide.rumour.lilmoth: Harbor traders in Lilmoth hire guards to escort spice barges past coastal corsairs.
skycraft.guide.arrive.murkmire: Vibrant swamp-blooms and towering Xanmeer pyramids rise from the southern depths of Murkmire.
skycraft.guide.rumour.murkmire: Cyrodilic Collections scholars in Murkmire pay handsomely for recovered Argonian calendar tablets.
skycraft.guide.arrive.anequina: Sun-bleached badlands and wind-scoured mesas stretch across the northern kingdom of Anequina.
skycraft.guide.rumour.anequina: Militia captains in Riverhold seek aid defending the northern passes from dragon-cult raiders.
skycraft.guide.arrive.rimmen: Aqueducts and palace terraces overlook the sugar-cane fields and canyons of Rimmen.
skycraft.guide.rumour.rimmen: Merchants in Rimmen's bazaar whisper of usurpers in the palace and ruins stirring in the scar.
skycraft.guide.arrive.torval: Incense and moon-bells echo from the terraced sanctuaries of Torval where the Mane holds court.
skycraft.guide.rumour.torval: Moon-priests in Torval seek champions to relight the Two-Moons shrines across the forest edge.
skycraft.guide.arrive.pellitine: Warm monsoon rains nourish the lush jungles and spice groves of southern Pellitine.
skycraft.guide.rumour.pellitine: Caravan leaders in Pellitine post rewards for clearing bandit ambushes along the sugar roads.
skycraft.guide.arrive.senchal: Colorful sails and gilded pagoda roofs gleam above the southern harbor of Senchal.
skycraft.guide.rumour.senchal: Shields of Senchal knights recruit able adventurers to restore order in the port's outer wards.
skycraft.guide.arrive.malabal_tor: Canopies so thick they swallow the noon sun shelter the migratory tree-boughs of Malabal Tor.
skycraft.guide.rumour.malabal_tor: Spinners in Falinesti's summer site seek help calming a Hound-spirit riling the forest.
skycraft.guide.arrive.reapers_march: Golden savannas and ancient Khajiiti temples meet the northern border-woods of Reaper's March.
skycraft.guide.rumour.reapers_march: Commanders in Arenthia need scouts to investigate dark Colovian incursions along the border.
skycraft.guide.arrive.grahtwood: Colossal graht-oaks wide as citadels lift the bough-halls of Elden Root into the clouds.
skycraft.guide.rumour.grahtwood: Envoys at Elden Root's great tree offer contracts to recover relics from Ayleid vaults below.
skycraft.guide.arrive.greenshade: Crystal springs and flower-carpeted glades wind toward the western shores of Greenshade.
skycraft.guide.rumour.greenshade: Rangers in Woodhearth warn of sea-raiders and shadow-beasts encroaching on the Wilderking's court.
skycraft.guide.arrive.summerset_isle: Alabaster towers and prismatic glass spires catch the sea-light above the gardens of Alinor.
skycraft.guide.rumour.summerset_isle: Sapiarchs in Alinor seek discreet outsiders to investigate sea-cavern cultists along the coast.
skycraft.guide.arrive.auridon: Cherry-blossom groves and white marble sanctuaries line the eastern shores of Auridon.
skycraft.guide.rumour.auridon: Queen's Eyes agents in Firsthold watch for Veiled Heritance conspirators in the high estates.
skycraft.guide.arrive.artaeum: Beyond the reach of ordinary charts, the timeless orchards of Artaeum drift in quiet serenity.
skycraft.guide.rumour.artaeum: Ritemasters of the Psijic Order ask travellers to seal unstable time-breaches across Nirn.
skycraft.guide.arrive.ice_waste: Howling blizzards and blue glacier walls stretch endlessly across the frozen wastes of old Atmora.
skycraft.guide.rumour.ice_waste: Ancient Atmoran cairns hold Frostfall relics guarded by draugr of the First Era.
skycraft.guide.arrive.frozen_forest: Rime-coated pines stand frozen in stone-still silence beneath the northern aurora of Atmora.
skycraft.guide.rumour.frozen_forest: Explorers speak of totem-halls buried beneath the frost-bound timberline.
skycraft.guide.arrive.tsaesci: Jade-roofed fortresses and bamboo mists guard the coiled valleys of Tsaesci in Akavir.
skycraft.guide.rumour.tsaesci: Blademasters at the river citadels test outsiders who seek the ancient Akaviri stances.
skycraft.guide.arrive.kamal: Jagged ice-peaks and thaw-flooded fjords mark the harsh northern domain of Kamal.
skycraft.guide.rumour.kamal: Outpost wardens offer high bounties to hold back snow-demon warbands descending from the glaciers.
skycraft.guide.arrive.tang_mo: Mist-wreathed mountain arches and terraced island shrines rise above theThousand Monkey Isles.
skycraft.guide.rumour.tang_mo: Monks of the island monasteries welcome allies against coastal raiders.
skycraft.guide.arrive.ka_po_tun: Golden steppes and monumental tiger-carved gates blaze under the eastern sun of Ka Po' Tun.
skycraft.guide.rumour.ka_po_tun: Dragon-cat champions offer trials of strength at the great temple steps.
skycraft.guide.arrive.yokudan_desert: Shattered red plateaus and sunken sword-temples remain above the waves of lost Yokuda.
skycraft.guide.rumour.yokudan_desert: Ansei pilgrim-stones hum with memory-echoes for those who walk the desert shrines.
skycraft.guide.arrive.sunken_isles: Coral-crowned ruins and sea-caves mark the outer archipelago of sunken Yokuda.
skycraft.guide.rumour.sunken_isles: Corsair captains trade maps to Orichalc vaults half-claimed by the tide.
skycraft.guide.arrive.maormer_isles: Mist-shrouded kelp forests and serpent-prowed docks surround the tropical fastness of Pyandonea.
skycraft.guide.rumour.maormer_isles: Sea-serpent callers gather around the storm-spires of the Maormer anchorage.
skycraft.guide.arrive.coral_kingdom: Looming coral spires and eerie lagoon Pools rise from the reef-ringed waters of Thras.
skycraft.guide.rumour.coral_kingdom: Expedition captains warn of necromantic coral-towers Rising from the central lagoon.
